persons.name: Bhaṭṭa
persons.evidence: bhaṭṭasyedaṃ pustakam iti || ... alekhi vai parahitaṃ svārthaṃ ca bhaṭṭena

purpose: for devotees and for the benefit of others as well as for himself (sadbhaktārtham ... parahitaṃ svārthaṃ ca)
notes: 'Bhaṭṭa' may be a family name or brahmin title (Bhaṭṭa/Bhaṭ) rather than a personal name. The scribe's given name is not stated. The date gives no year or pakṣa, only Mārgaśīrṣa daśamī. The final verse line 'sadvidyāyurgguṇino gadaṃtu viduṣā cintākhyakanādarān(?)' is corrupt. It seems to be a request that learned readers bless the copyist with knowledge, long life and virtues. No other person can safely be read from it ('cintākhya' is unclear). The text is attributed to the Āgneya/Vahni Purāṇa, so no human author is extracted.
